title: The 100 billion dollar race to build humanoid robots

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this — the race to build humanoid robots is now a 100 billion dollar battleground.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Big tech and startups are fighting to be first with fully functional humanoids.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It's about creating robots that can walk, talk, and work like us — think Boston Dynamics, Tesla Optimus.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest challenge? Making them move smoothly and think on their feet.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could change how we work, care for the elderly, and even live our daily lives.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway: The future of robotics is here, and it's moving fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know who's winning this race? Follow me — we’re diving deeper next.
